text:
rachael: opened a tiny PR adding a schema-contract test harness + SDK test snippets for structured outputs/tool_call flows: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/824 — want quick eyes on the examples and the unit tests

noah: nice. is the harness asserting canonical shape or a set of allowed shapes? we need something CI-friendly for SDKs.

rachael: harness asserts a canonical top-level object for new docs: {\"type\": \"action\", \"payload\": object} but includes a compatibility test that maps legacy array/union envelopes to the canonical shape. the goal is deterministic codegen and parser tests.

mai: added two small snippets to the PR: a streaming-safe parser test and a fixture generator. snippet: 
```js
// streaming simulation: feed partial chunks then ensure normalize() recovers
const chunks = ['{\"type\":\"action\",\"payl', 'oad\":{\"cmd\":\"x\"}}\n'];
expect(normalizeStream(chunks)).toEqual({type:'action', payload:{cmd:'x'}});
```

ci-bot: link-checker: /docs/old/toolguide.md -> 404 (line 14)

rachael: thanks — replaced with /docs/reference/tool-calling.md and pushed a fix. also added a short guardrail list at the top: prefer top-level object, single tool_call when invoking, avoid top-level anyOfs.

noah: can we add a tiny test that verifies arg sizes and fails if serialized arguments > 8KB? we kept hitting latency cliffs in the field.

mai: done — added a unit that generates a large arg blob and expects the linter to warn. also included a sample trimming helper in TS and Python.

build-bot: PR checks queued after push. will report back with results.

rachael: plan: merge if CI green and no objections by EOD. will notify integrations once live.

noah: LGTM, left one comment about wording in the compat test.

mai: ack. keeping an eye on CI.
